artifact_observations.reasoning: A thin black line extends from the nose of the airship down to a vague white blob in the distance. This physical connection is highly improbable for a flying airship (which would not drag a tether to a cloud or distant object). The white object lacks definition and looks like a generative artifact or 'melting' into the sky. The line itself has no clear anchor point on the white object.

The yellow lettering on the side resembles text but is not legible English or any standard script. It appears as pseudo-text, a common AI artifact where letterforms are approximated but not structurally valid.
The details within the gondola are muddy and lack sharp geometric definition. The windows appear as indistinct smudges rather than clear glass panes, suggesting slight texture generation issues.
